hints.down-1: Each of the seven major bodies which move relative to the fixed stars in the night sky—the Moon, Mercury, Venus, the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn.
hints.across-2: Assemblage of things or people seen as luminous or brilliant.
hints.down-3: God of fertility and agriculture, equivalent to the Greek Cronos.
hints.down-4: Planet thought to influence one's fate; fate or luck.
hints.down-5: Fixed one-dimensional figure, such as a line or arc, with an origin and orientation and such that its points are in one-to-one correspondence with a set of numbers; an axis forms part of the basis of a space or is used to position and locate data in a graph
hints.across-6: Month of an average of approximately 29.53 days, measured from a lunar phase until the return of that same phase.
